(use-trait ft-trait 'SPKBM7Q8T701H0CDHHW03QR0PHF2K8B1SNRQCGTX.ft-trait.ft-trait)

(define-constant ERR-PAUSED (err u870001))
(define-constant ERR-CAP-EXCEEDED (err u870002))
(define-constant ERR-BELOW-MIN (err u870003))
(define-constant ERR-NO-CLAIM (err u870004))
(define-constant ERR-NOT-COOLED-DOWN (err u870005))
(define-constant ERR-ALREADY-FUNDED (err u870006))
(define-constant ERR-NOT-FUNDED (err u870007))
(define-constant ERR-NOT-AUTHORIZED (err u870008))
(define-constant ERR-CANCEL-EXPRESS (err u870009))
(define-constant ERR-REWARD-TOO-LARGE (err u870010))
(define-constant ERR-UPDATE-WINDOW (err u870011))
(define-constant ERR-DEVIATION (err u870012))
(define-constant ERR-ZERO-POSITIVE-ONLY (err u870013))
(define-constant ERR-ZERO-SHARES (err u870014))
(define-constant ERR-EXPRESS-DISABLED (err u870015))
(define-constant ERR-SLIPPAGE (err u870016))

(define-constant SHARE-BASE u100000000)
(define-constant BPS-BASE u10000)
(define-constant PCT-BASE u100)
(define-constant DEAD-SHARES u1000)
(define-constant NULL-ADDRESS (unwrap-panic
  (principal-construct? (if is-in-mainnet 0x16 0x1a)
    0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000)))

(define-public (initialize (token <ft-trait>))
  (let ((supply (unwrap-panic (contract-call? .p3b2 get-total-supply))))
    (asserts! (is-eq supply u0) ERR-ALREADY-FUNDED)
    (try! (contract-call? .p3c2 transfer-collateral-in token DEAD-SHARES tx-sender))
    (try! (contract-call? .p3b2 mint DEAD-SHARES NULL-ADDRESS))
    (try! (contract-call? .p3c2 add-total-assets DEAD-SHARES))
    (print { action: "sv-initialize", user: tx-sender,
             data: { dead-shares: DEAD-SHARES } })
    (ok true)))

(define-public (deposit (token <ft-trait>) (amount uint) (min-shares-out uint))
  (let (
    (state (contract-call? .p3c2 get-deposit-state))
    (supply (unwrap-panic (contract-call? .p3b2 get-total-supply)))
    (net-assets (if (>= (get total-assets state) (+ (get pending-fees state) (get pending-rf state)))
                    (- (- (get total-assets state) (get pending-fees state)) (get pending-rf state))
                    u0))
    (shares (if (> net-assets u0) (/ (* amount supply) net-assets) u0))
  )
    (asserts! (get vault-enabled state) ERR-PAUSED)
    (asserts! (get deposit-enabled state) ERR-PAUSED)
    (asserts! (>= amount (get min-deposit state)) ERR-BELOW-MIN)
    (asserts! (or (is-eq (get deposit-cap state) u0)
                  (<= (+ (get total-assets state) amount) (get deposit-cap state)))
              ERR-CAP-EXCEEDED)
    (asserts! (> shares u0) ERR-ZERO-SHARES)
    (asserts! (>= shares min-shares-out) ERR-SLIPPAGE)
    (try! (contract-call? .p3c2 transfer-collateral-in token amount tx-sender))
    (try! (contract-call? .p3b2 mint shares tx-sender))
    (try! (contract-call? .p3c2 add-total-assets amount))
    (print { action: "sv-deposit", user: tx-sender,
             data: { asset: "stbtc", amount: amount, shares: shares, net-assets: net-assets } })
    (ok shares)))

(define-public (deposit-sbtc (amount uint) (min-shares-out uint))
  (let (
    (state (contract-call? .p3c2 get-deposit-state))
    (supply (unwrap-panic (contract-call? .p3b2 get-total-supply)))
    (net-assets (if (>= (get total-assets state) (+ (get pending-fees state) (get pending-rf state)))
                    (- (- (get total-assets state) (get pending-fees state)) (get pending-rf state))
                    u0))
  )
    (asserts! (get vault-enabled state) ERR-PAUSED)
    (asserts! (get deposit-enabled state) ERR-PAUSED)
    (asserts! (>= amount (get min-deposit state)) ERR-BELOW-MIN)
    (try! (contract-call? .p3c2 transfer-sbtc-in 'SM3VDXK3WZZSA84XXFKAFAF15NNZX32CTSG82JFQ4.sbtc-token amount tx-sender))
    (let ((stbtc-received (try! (contract-call? .p3d3 stack-sbtc-to-state amount)))
          (shares (if (> net-assets u0) (/ (* stbtc-received supply) net-assets) u0)))
      (asserts! (or (is-eq (get deposit-cap state) u0)
                    (<= (+ (get total-assets state) stbtc-received) (get deposit-cap state)))
                ERR-CAP-EXCEEDED)
      (asserts! (> stbtc-received u0) ERR-ZERO-SHARES)
      (asserts! (> shares u0) ERR-ZERO-SHARES)
      (asserts! (>= shares min-shares-out) ERR-SLIPPAGE)
      (try! (contract-call? .p3b2 mint shares tx-sender))
      (try! (contract-call? .p3c2 add-total-assets stbtc-received))
      (print { action: "sv-deposit", user: tx-sender,
               data: { asset: "sbtc", sbtc-in: amount,
                       stbtc-received: stbtc-received, shares: shares,
                       net-assets: net-assets } })
      (ok shares))))

(define-public (report-yield (reward uint) (is-positive bool))
  (begin
    (asserts! (contract-call? .p3c2 is-rewarder contract-caller) ERR-NOT-AUTHORIZED)
    (log-reward reward is-positive)))

(define-public (request-redeem (assets uint) (is-express bool))
  (let (
    (state (contract-call? .p3c2 get-redeem-state))
    (supply (unwrap-panic (contract-call? .p3b2 get-total-supply)))
    (net-assets (- (- (get total-assets state) (get pending-fees state))
                   (get pending-rf state)))
    (assets-safe (if (> assets net-assets) net-assets assets))
    (shares-raw (if (or (is-eq supply u0) (is-eq net-assets u0)) assets-safe
                    (/ (+ (* assets-safe supply) (- net-assets u1)) net-assets)))
    (user-balance (unwrap-panic (contract-call? .p3b2 get-balance tx-sender)))
    (shares (if (> shares-raw user-balance) user-balance shares-raw))
    (fee-bps (if is-express (get express-fee-bps state) (get exit-fee-bps state)))
    (cd (if is-express (get express-cooldown state) (get cooldown state)))
    (ts (+ stacks-block-time cd))
    (request-price (contract-call? .p3c2 get-share-price))
  )
    (asserts! (get vault-enabled state) ERR-PAUSED)
    (asserts! (get redeem-enabled state) ERR-PAUSED)
    (asserts! (>= assets (get min-redeem state)) ERR-BELOW-MIN)
    (asserts! (> shares u0) ERR-ZERO-SHARES)
    (asserts! (> net-assets u0) ERR-BELOW-MIN)
    (if is-express
      (asserts! (get express-enabled state) ERR-EXPRESS-DISABLED)
      true)
    (try! (contract-call? .p3b2 transfer shares tx-sender current-contract none))
    (let ((claim-id (try! (contract-call? .p3c2 next-claim-id))))
      (try! (contract-call? .p3c2 set-claim claim-id
        { user: tx-sender, shares: shares, share-price: (some request-price),
          assets: none, fee: none, fee-bps: fee-bps,
          ts: ts, is-express: is-express }))
      (print { action: "sv-request-redeem", user: tx-sender,
               data: { claim-id: claim-id, shares: shares,
                       assets-requested: assets-safe,
                       cooldown: cd, fee-bps: fee-bps, ts: ts,
                       is-express: is-express } })
      (ok claim-id))))

(define-public (fund-claim (claim-id uint))
  (let (
    (claim (unwrap! (contract-call? .p3c2 get-claim claim-id) ERR-NO-CLAIM))
    (is-mgr (contract-call? .p3c2 is-manager-or-engine contract-caller))
    (is-cooled-down (>= stacks-block-time (get ts claim)))
    (state (contract-call? .p3c2 get-fund-claim-state))
    (share-price (default-to (contract-call? .p3c2 get-share-price)
                             (get share-price claim)))
    (shares (get shares claim))
    (assets-quoted (/ (* shares share-price) SHARE-BASE))
    (claimable (contract-call? .p3c2 get-claimable-assets shares))
    (assets (if (> assets-quoted claimable) claimable assets-quoted))
    (fee (/ (* assets (get fee-bps claim)) BPS-BASE))
  )
    (asserts! (or is-mgr is-cooled-down) ERR-NOT-COOLED-DOWN)
    (asserts! (is-none (get assets claim)) ERR-ALREADY-FUNDED)
    (asserts! (get vault-enabled state) ERR-PAUSED)
    (asserts! (> assets u0) ERR-BELOW-MIN)
    (asserts!
      (>= (unwrap-panic (contract-call? 'SP4SZE494VC2YC5JYG7AYFQ44F5Q4PYV7DVMDPBG.stbtc-token get-balance .p3c2))
          (+ (get funded-claim-liability state) (- assets fee)))
      ERR-BELOW-MIN)
    (try! (contract-call? .p3c2 set-claim claim-id
      (merge claim { share-price: (some share-price), assets: (some assets), fee: (some fee) })))
    (try! (contract-call? .p3b2 burn shares current-contract))
    (try! (contract-call? .p3c2 sub-total-assets assets))
    (try! (contract-call? .p3c2 add-claim-liability (- assets fee)))
    (print { action: "sv-fund-claim", user: contract-caller,
             data: { claim-id: claim-id, shares: shares, assets: assets,
                     assets-quoted: assets-quoted, fee: fee,
                     share-price: share-price } })
    (ok assets)))

(define-public (redeem (token <ft-trait>) (claim-id uint))
  (let (
    (claim (unwrap! (contract-call? .p3c2 get-claim claim-id) ERR-NO-CLAIM))
    (assets (unwrap! (get assets claim) ERR-NOT-FUNDED))
    (fee (unwrap-panic (get fee claim)))
    (user (get user claim))
    (assets-net (- assets fee))
    (state (contract-call? .p3c2 get-fund-claim-state))
  )
    (asserts! (>= stacks-block-time (get ts claim)) ERR-NOT-COOLED-DOWN)
    (asserts! (get vault-enabled state) ERR-PAUSED)
    (try! (contract-call? .p3c2 transfer-collateral-out token assets-net user))
    (try! (contract-call? .p3c2 sub-claim-liability assets-net))
    (try! (contract-call? .p3c2 delete-claim claim-id))
    (print { action: "sv-redeem", user: tx-sender,
             data: { claim-id: claim-id, assets: assets, fee: fee,
                     assets-net: assets-net, user: user } })
    (ok assets-net)))

(define-public (cancel-redeem (claim-id uint))
  (let (
    (claim (unwrap! (contract-call? .p3c2 get-claim claim-id) ERR-NO-CLAIM))
    (shares (get shares claim))
  )
    (asserts! (is-eq contract-caller (get user claim)) ERR-NOT-AUTHORIZED)
    (asserts! (is-none (get assets claim)) ERR-ALREADY-FUNDED)
    (asserts! (not (get is-express claim)) ERR-CANCEL-EXPRESS)
    (try! (as-contract? ((with-ft .p3b2 "*" shares))
      (try! (contract-call? .p3b2 transfer shares tx-sender (get user claim) none))))
    (try! (contract-call? .p3c2 delete-claim claim-id))
    (print { action: "sv-cancel-redeem", user: contract-caller,
             data: { claim-id: claim-id, shares: shares } })
    (ok shares)))

(define-public (log-reward (reward uint) (is-positive bool))
  (let (
    (state (contract-call? .p3c2 get-reward-state))
    (supply (unwrap-panic (contract-call? .p3b2 get-total-supply)))
    (ta (get total-assets state))
    (pf (get pending-fees state))
    (prf (get pending-rf state))
    (rf (get reserve-fund state))
    (net (- ta pf prf))
    (old-share-price (if (> supply u0) (/ (* net SHARE-BASE) supply) SHARE-BASE))
    (mgmt-fee (/ (* (get mgmt-fee-bps state) net) BPS-BASE PCT-BASE))
    (reward-after-mgmt (if (>= reward mgmt-fee) (- reward mgmt-fee) u0))
    (perf-fee (if is-positive (/ (* (get perf-fee-bps state) reward-after-mgmt) BPS-BASE) u0))
    (total-fees (+ perf-fee mgmt-fee))
    (is-profit (and is-positive (>= reward total-fees)))
    (req-rf (if is-profit u0
              (if is-positive (- mgmt-fee reward) (+ mgmt-fee reward))))
    (total-rf (+ rf prf))
  )
    (asserts! (or (contract-call? .p3c2 is-ops contract-caller)
                  (contract-call? .p3c2 is-engine contract-caller)
                  (contract-call? .p3c2 is-rewarder contract-caller))
              ERR-NOT-AUTHORIZED)
    (asserts! (get reward-enabled state) ERR-PAUSED)
    (asserts! (get vault-enabled state) ERR-PAUSED)
    (asserts! (or (> reward u0) is-positive) ERR-ZERO-POSITIVE-ONLY)
    (asserts! (> supply u0) ERR-ZERO-SHARES)
    (asserts! (>= stacks-block-time (+ (get last-reward-ts state) (get update-window state)))
              ERR-UPDATE-WINDOW)
    (asserts! (<= reward (/ (* (get max-reward-bps state) ta) BPS-BASE))
              ERR-REWARD-TOO-LARGE)
    (if is-profit
      (let (
        (reward-after-fees (- reward total-fees))
        (reward-rf (/ (* reward-after-fees (get reserve-rate-bps state)) BPS-BASE))
        (reward-net (- reward-after-fees reward-rf))
        (new-ta (+ ta reward))
        (new-pf (+ pf total-fees))
        (new-prf (+ prf reward-rf))
      )
        (try! (contract-call? .p3c2 update-accounting
                new-ta new-pf new-prf rf stacks-block-time))
        (print { action: "sv-log-reward", user: contract-caller,
                 data: { case: "profit", reward: reward, net: reward-net,
                         fees: total-fees, rf-alloc: reward-rf } })
        true
      )
      (if (<= req-rf total-rf)
        (let (
          (transfer-from-rf (if (> req-rf prf) (- req-rf prf) u0))
          (prf-decrease (- req-rf transfer-from-rf))
          (new-rf (- rf transfer-from-rf))
          (new-prf-val (- prf prf-decrease))
          (new-ta (if (> mgmt-fee prf-decrease)
                    (+ ta (- mgmt-fee prf-decrease))
                    (- ta (- prf-decrease mgmt-fee))))
        )
          (try! (contract-call? .p3c2 update-accounting
                  new-ta (+ pf mgmt-fee) new-prf-val new-rf stacks-block-time))
          (print { action: "sv-log-reward", user: contract-caller,
                   data: { case: "loss-covered", reward: reward, req-rf: req-rf } })
          true
        )
        (let (
          (transfer-from-rf (if (> total-rf prf) (- total-rf prf) u0))
          (excess-loss (- req-rf total-rf))
          (new-ta (if is-positive
                    (+ ta reward transfer-from-rf)
                    (if (>= reward transfer-from-rf)
                      (- ta (- reward transfer-from-rf))
                      (+ ta (- transfer-from-rf reward)))))
        )
          (try! (contract-call? .p3c2 update-accounting
                  new-ta (+ pf mgmt-fee) u0 u0 stacks-block-time))
          (print { action: "sv-log-reward", user: contract-caller,
                   data: { case: "loss-exceeds", reward: reward,
                           rf-drained: total-rf, excess: excess-loss } })
          true
        )))
    (let (
      (new-net (contract-call? .p3c2 get-net-assets))
      (new-share-price (if (> supply u0) (/ (* new-net SHARE-BASE) supply) SHARE-BASE))
      (abs-diff (if (> new-share-price old-share-price)
                  (- new-share-price old-share-price)
                  (- old-share-price new-share-price)))
      (deviation (if (> old-share-price u0)
                   (/ (* abs-diff BPS-BASE) old-share-price) u0))
    )
      (asserts! (<= deviation (get max-deviation-bps state)) ERR-DEVIATION)
      (ok true))))

(define-public (settle-fees)
  (begin
    (asserts! (contract-call? .p3c2 is-manager-or-engine contract-caller)
              ERR-NOT-AUTHORIZED)
    (contract-call? .p3c2 settle-fees)))
